system.description:
Lore: Relic Scroll (Consumable)

Found on the crowned rooftop of Grimskalle. It has the following Powers:

  • Inscribed Casting: Holds a single Casting of @UUID[Compendium.vagabond-rpg.spells.Item.oKWudg74hQmu9Ud7]{Cure}, at the Rank it was scribed. Reading it aloud Casts the Spell without spending Mana and consumes the scroll.

Value: 100g
system.source: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden (Vagabond conversion)
